verdict.rationale: Attio has a documented REST API for creating/updating records (attio-docs-2, attio-docs-8/9/14) and an official MCP server (attio-probe-3, attio-docs-3, attio-docs-12) letting AI tools search, update and create records, and separately advertises 'automatic data enrichment' (attio-docs-26/45/47). However, there is no explicit documentation showing an end-to-end workflow of creating a lead, auto-filling company data, and assigning an owner in one API/MCP call chain — owner-assignment and enrichment-via-API/MCP specifics are unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP example of owner assignment, documented enrichment endpoint/field mapping, and a hands-on end-to-end example combining all three steps.
